headline: Should Earnings Beat, Rising Premiums and Buybacks Require Action From Chubb (CB) Investors?
summary: In the past quarter, Chubb reported Q2 2026 results that exceeded expectations, supported by higher underwriting and investment income and 3.6% growth in net premiums written across its P&C and Life Insurance businesses, while also advancing leadership changes at its Tempest Re reinsurance unit and completing a large share repurchase program initiated in May 2025. An interesting angle for investors is how the combination of earnings outperformance and capital returns via buybacks may...
